scope: digital RAW serializer model; not cable/PCB limit or measured FPGA/P4 pad waveform

assumptions.extended_clock: assumed160MHz divider N/N+1 period accumulator with floor/ceil half cycles; actual hardware duty/period ordering unmeasured
assumptions.delays: fixed equal outgoing CLK/DIR/data and return data/READY; added Tco only on returned data; no analog noise/rise/fall/jitter
assumptions.fixture: pseudo-random address-varying color/depth; independent expected sequence checks every byte
